title: Xray

notice.selectFailed: The node was not selected (xray-omarchy select exited with code %1).

notice.tunnelOffTimeout: The tunnel did not go down within a minute — see xray-omarchy status.

nodes.notRunning: The core is not running — nodes cannot be picked.

recent.notRunning: The core is not running — no connections to show.
on.start_failed: The tunnel did not start: the core service failed to start.

off.killswitch_failed: The tunnel stays on: the killswitch did not lift.
off.stop_failed: The tunnel stays on: the core did not stop.

guard.code.unknown: the CLI reports a problem without naming it
subs.skippedLegacy: some links skipped (reasons after the next update)
subs.skip.clash_format: clash (yaml) format, a v2ray link is needed
on.exitCode: The tunnel did not start (xray-omarchy on exited with code %1).
off.exitCode: The tunnel did not stop (xray-omarchy off exited with code %1).
notice.fallbackFailed: The fallback setting did not change (xray-omarchy fallback exited with code %1).
notice.notifyFailed: Notifications did not switch (xray-omarchy notify exited with code %1).
notice.ruleFailed: The rule did not change (xray-omarchy rule exited with code %1).

select.not_found: That node is no longer in the active subscription.
select.restarted: Node switched; the core restarted to apply it.
select.restart_needed: Node switched; the fallback node starts working after a core restart.
fallback.restarted: The core restarted; the fallback setting is in effect.
fallback.restartLater: Saved. Node probing changes on the next core restart.
fallback.apply_failed: Saved, but the running core did not accept it; it applies on the next restart.
fallback.not_node_mode: The fallback works only with a node picked by hand, not with Auto.
fallback.primary_not_node: The picked entry is a group, not a node.
fallback.no_fallback_node: No fallback node is picked yet.
fallback.fallback_not_found: The fallback node is not in the active subscription.
fallback.same_node: The fallback node must differ from the picked one.
fallback.other: The fallback setting did not change.
rule.invalid_host: %1 cannot take a rule: not a domain or an IPv4 address.
rule.apply_failed: The rule for %1 is saved, but the running core did not accept it; it applies on the next restart.
rule.other: The rule for %1 did not change.
settings.notifyHint: Desktop alerts when protection drops, a node goes down or the fallback takes over.
settings.russiaHint: Russian sites (the category-ru list, Russian addresses, the .ru and .su zones and the Cyrillic .rf zone) go past the tunnel and are resolved by your network's DNS. Off: everything goes through the tunnel.
settings.fallbackHint: If the picked node stops answering, traffic moves to this one in about 30 s and comes back by itself once it recovers.
settings.fallbackNeedsNode: Works with a node picked by hand, not with Auto.
settings.fallbackPick: Pick the fallback node below first.
settings.noCandidates: No other node answers right now.
settings.restartNeeded: Takes full effect after a core restart.
settings.confirmRestart: Restart the core to apply the fallback setting? The connection drops for a few seconds.
settings.confirmPreset: Restart the core to apply the Russia setting? The connection drops for a few seconds.
preset.saved: Saved; it applies when the tunnel starts.
preset.restartNeeded: Saved; it applies after a core restart.
notice.presetFailed: The setting was not changed (xray-omarchy preset exited with code %1).
corePage.checkFailed: Could not check for a new release.
corePage.unpinned: xray %1 is out. It comes with the next package update (Update components…), once its checksum is pinned.
corePage.confirm: Update the xray core to %1? The connection drops for a few seconds; if the new core fails, the previous one comes back by itself.
corePage.last.rolled_back: the new core failed, rolled back
corePage.last.stage_failed: the new core was not accepted, nothing changed
core.up_to_date: The core is already the latest (%1).
core.rolled_back: The new core failed; %1 is back.
core.stage_failed: The root helper did not accept the new core; nothing changed.
core.not_pinned: This package does not pin that xray version yet: update the components first.
core.lost: The core update stopped without a result — see xray-omarchy core status.
core.timeout: The core update gave no result within 10 minutes — see xray-omarchy core status.
core.download_failed: The new core did not download; nothing was installed.
core.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded core failed its checksum; nothing was installed.
core.config_rejected: The new core rejects the current config; nothing was installed.
core.check_failed: Could not check the latest release.
setup.title: Xray is not set up yet
setup.body: The panel works through the xray-omarchy package: a command-line tool, a small root helper for routes, the killswitch and system DNS, and systemd units. It also needs the xray core, the official XTLS release.
setup.outdated: The installed components (%1) are older than the panel (%2).
setup.hint: Opens a terminal that explains each step and asks before it changes anything. Your password goes only to sudo there.
empty.title: Add your first subscription
empty.body: Paste the subscription link from your provider. Its nodes appear here once it downloads; then turn the tunnel on.
addSub.body: A link from your provider (https://…): a list of vless, trojan, shadowsocks, vmess or hysteria2 links, base64, or xray JSON.
addSub.badUrl: Paste one http(s) link, without spaces.
addSub.name: Name
addSub.badName: Up to 40 characters, not starting with a dash.
notice.subNotFetched: Subscription %1 added, but it did not download.
subadd.invalid_url: Not added: the link is not an http(s) link.
subadd.invalid_name: Not added: the name is not usable.
subadd.usage: Not added: a name and a link are needed.
subadd.insecure_url: Not added: the link is plain http. Use https, or press “Allow plain HTTP” first.
addSub.httpWarning: This link is plain http: anyone on the way (Wi-Fi, provider) can read it and swap the nodes for their own. Use https if the provider has it.
addSub.allowHttp: Allow plain HTTP for this link
addSub.httpAllowed: Plain HTTP allowed for this link
on.foreign_tun: The tunnel did not start: the device xray-omarchy0 is held by something other than your xray core.
on.foreign_dns: The tunnel is up, but 127.0.0.1:53 is held by something other than your xray core: system DNS was not switched.
guard.code.killswitch_tampered: the killswitch table was changed after it was loaded
core.stage_busy: Another core installation is running; try again when it is done.
core.no_space: Not enough free disk space for the new core; nothing changed.
corePage.last.stage_busy: another installation was running, nothing changed
corePage.last.no_space: not enough disk space, nothing changed
on.not_routed: The tunnel did not come up: the routes into the tunnel could not be set. It keeps trying by itself; the killswitch holds traffic meanwhile.
install.stale_db: Your package databases are out of date. Run `omarchy update` first, then use this button again.
shell.restartNeeded: The panel was updated to %1. Restart the shell to finish updating.
sites.hint: Checks if the site opens and which way it goes: through which node, or direct. No sites yet.
addSite.body: Checks if the site opens and which way it goes: through which node, or direct. While the tunnel runs it is checked once a minute, and a notification says when it stops opening.
addSite.badUrl: One https link to a site, without spaces.
addSite.name: Name
siteadd.invalid_url: Not added: the link is not an https link to a site.
siteadd.insecure_url: Not added: only https links are checked.
siteadd.invalid_name: Not added: the name is not usable.
siteadd.too_many: Not added: at most 10 sites are checked.
siteadd.usage: Not added: a name and a link are needed.
siterm.not_found: %1 is not on the list any more.
notice.siteNotifyFailed: Site notifications did not switch (xray-omarchy site notify exited with code %1).
settings.siteNotifyHint: When a checked site stops opening (three checks in a row) and when it opens again. Checked once a minute while the tunnel runs.
settings.siteNotifyMuted: Notifications are off above, so these are silent too.
